theme.title: One year apart
theme.subtitle: The 2008 and 2009 Finals
theme.recap: The Lakers lost a 21-point first-quarter lead to Boston in 2008, then came back to win the 2009 title.

questions.prompt: The 2009 title was which championship in Lakers history?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers defeated the Magic in five games to win the franchise's 15th NBA championship

funFacts.text: The Lakers' return to the summit came one year after their Finals defeat to rival Boston.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was the seventh time in NBA Finals history that a team that lost the championship the previous season has won

funFacts.text: Orlando's only win in the series was its first Finals game victory in franchise history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Orlando Magic's Game 3 victory was the first win in an NBA Finals game in franchise history

funFacts.text: Los Angeles beat Orlando in a series nicknamed the 'Disney Series' because of the nearby theme parks.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This series was nicknamed the "Disney Series"

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant won 2009 Finals MVP. What did he average in the series?
questions.context: 2009 NBA Finals · five games vs Orlando

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant averaged 32.4 points, 5.6 rebounds, and 7.4 assists per game during the series

funFacts.text: Kobe and opponent Dwight Howard had won Olympic gold together for Team USA the previous summer.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the previous summer, winning a gold medal at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing

funFacts.text: Pau Gasol became the first Spanish player to celebrate an NBA championship as a player.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pau Gasol became the first Spaniard

funFacts.text: Kobe received the Bill Russell Finals MVP trophy from commissioner David Stern in Orlando.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: presented Kobe Bryant with the Bill Russell NBA Finals MVP Trophy

questions.prompt: The Lakers and Magic set a Finals record low for combined first-quarter points in Game 2 of 2009. What was it?
questions.context: 2009 NBA Finals · Game 2 · at Los Angeles

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: setting a record-low for combined score (30) in the first quarter of an NBA Finals game

funFacts.text: Rashard Lewis carried almost all of Orlando's second-quarter scoring after the slow opening.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rashard Lewis kept the Magic in the game, scoring 18 of the team's 20 points

funFacts.text: Hedo Türkoğlu briefly thought he had hit a three, until replay showed his foot on the line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: replay showed that his foot was on the line

funFacts.text: Courtney Lee missed a late layup attempt that could have transformed the entire series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: forced Courtney Lee to miss an awkward layup shot

questions.prompt: The defending champion Celtics set a franchise-record winning streak in 2008–09. How long was it?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: bringing an end to their franchise-high 19-game winning streak

funFacts.text: The Lakers ended Boston's franchise-best regular-season run in a highly anticipated Christmas Day rematch.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: their momentum halted when they faced the Lakers on Christmas Day

funFacts.text: Boston's dramatic early record came after an off-season with high expectations as defending champions.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics got off to an impressive start with a 27–2 record

funFacts.text: Kevin Garnett's knee injury later sidelined him for Boston's elimination by Orlando in the East semifinals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kevin Garnett suffered a devastating right knee injury

questions.prompt: In Game 4 of the 2008 Finals, the Lakers set a Finals record for a first-quarter lead. How big was it?
questions.note: 21 points, 35–14. Boston came back to win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: a 35–14 lead after the first quarter, which was the largest first-quarter lead in NBA Finals history

funFacts.text: Boston's reserve Eddie House finally put the Celtics ahead with a fourth-quarter jumper.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics took their first lead in the game when Celtics' reserve Eddie House

funFacts.text: Boston's bench outscored Los Angeles's reserves as Eddie House and James Posey changed the game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 29 of those points coming from House and James Posey

funFacts.text: Paul Pierce's unexpected 'Wheelchair Game' return was another defining moment of this series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: It was later dubbed by some as the "Wheelchair Game"
